verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI email client that auto-categorizes and drafts replies, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains nothing on automation definitions, version history, review workflows, or rollback. The MCP capability list and the Drizzle Studio developer tooling are unrelated to versioning automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
